intervals.quote: It was commissioned successfully in a first run at the Institute Laue-Langevin (ILL) in 2007.

intervals.label: measurement runs at the ILL (2008/2009, 2014/2015, 2019/2020)
intervals.locator: TUM PERKEO III page, last paragraph
intervals.note: Runs: beta asymmetry A 2008/2009; proton asymmetry C 2014 and 2015; beta spectrum 2019 and 2020 ("Analysis of the data is ongoing"). No later run was found, so the interval is left open; whether the spectrometer is still in use at the ILL is not stated.
intervals.quote: In 2019 and 2020 we successfully performed a measurement of the beta spectrum with the aim to strongly improve the limits on the Fierz interfernce term b using an unpolarised, pulsed neutron beam.

placements.locator: TUM PERKEO III page, figure caption
placements.note: ILL reactor-hall campus-grade site; the PF1B hall is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: PERKEO III installed at the cold neutron beam line PF1b at the Institut Laue-Langevin, Grenoble, France.

summary.plain: An eight-metre magnet system in which the electrons and protons from neutron decays are guided to two detectors, with a pulsed neutron beam that lets the background be measured under the same conditions as the signal.
summary.technical: 8 m, 54-coil magnet system with a large decay volume accepting a large part of the natural beam divergence, two connected detector systems and a pulsed, polarized cold neutron beam at PF1B.

technology.quote: Like all PERKEO spectrometers, PERKEO III uses a magnetic field to transport electrons and protons from the decay region towards the detectors in a symmetric set-up, ensuring a solid angle acceptance of (almost) 4π.
technology.value: Magnetic spectrometer transporting electrons and protons from neutron decay to two detector systems in a symmetric set-up with almost 4π acceptance
